comparison_policy: Only the five named source-specific contrasts and same-record identity are classified. Other pair relationships remain unresolved; field comparison never turns missingness into equality or negation. Uncertain values are incomparable as resolved propositions.
index_policy: Topic, predicate and polarity tags are editorial source-grounded indexing, not a general entailment engine. User order retained; comparison facts use canonical source order.
historical_qualifications: Both20A and20B contain uncertain translated activity; neither is normalized to a confident activity.
19A and19B preserve different conditions and source day indices49/50;19B does not inherit19A lunar month. No elapsed absolute interval or Gregorian conversion.
Only source-explicit date/diviner/kinship/editorial information attaches to each record. No A/B suffix inference or cross-record inheritance.
All thirteen inspected excerpts omit prognostication and verification. A charge is not an event outcome.
24A/B are distinct propositions;23/24B and other unlisted pairs remain unresolved.
Modern translation/anthology/educational selection are distinct from original inscriptions; no invented Chinese, artifact inventory or crack characteristics.
Anthology compilers are identified; individual translator and case-specific printed page attribution are not independently established. These excerpts are not attributed to Keightley.
